Fossil

Released October 10, 1999 · 62 cards

Fossil is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Base series, released in English on October 10, 1999. It has 62 cards. It includes 57 Pokémon, 5 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.
